name: debian
description: Debian 12 (Bookworm). Intaked once. Runs anywhere Phoenix runs. No installer. No wizard. Phoenix brings the OS.
author: Debian project / Phoenix intake by jwl247

metadata.login_note: Root password login is blocked by Debian's default sshd config regardless of account state. Cloud-init (tools/poc/debian-seed/) creates a sudo-capable 'phoenix' user (password 'phoenix') instead -- see PHOENIX_MANUAL.md #4 'Running a full distro'. ssh -p 2222 phoenix@127.0.0.1 once booted.
metadata.shared_fs_note: Pass --share to 'usys run debian' to enable. Requires setup-shared-fs.ps1 run once on Windows. Debian auto-mounts via cloud-init + 9p fstab entries (noauto,x-systemd.automount). security_model=mapped-xattr — no elevation required.
